author: Kairos I
title: Erudite Annex v16: blend-mode (stacked hues) for multi-source notes
abstract: Generates a distinct v16 one-pager with stacked color-coded notes per source (run_file, per_run_json, summary_meta). Config-driven (priority, colors, wrap, total lines). Updates index_v3 with v16 pointers; TXT fallback included.
